decision.explanation: The question asks who directed the film *Imitation of Life*. The original sources distinguish two films with the same title: the 1934 version and the 1959 version. Document D1S1 explicitly states that the 1934 film was directed by John M. Stahl. Document D2S1 similarly states that the 1959 film was directed by Douglas Sirk. These are distinct referents (different films), so both answers are valid and complementary. There is no conflict between them.
